nodes.name: scaffolding
nodes.summary: Set up cargo workspace: ism-core + ism-cli
nodes.body: Workspace-level dependency pinning; core carries the domain logic, the CLI stays a shell (design rule: apps and CLI are both shells over ism-core).

nodes.name: core-foundation
nodes.summary: Core foundation: error codes, domain model, git plumbing IO
nodes.body: Stable error codes with agent-facing hints; serde types that ARE the JSON contract; a plumbing-only git wrapper (temp-index writes, CAS ref flips, never the worktree).

nodes.name: diff-algebra
nodes.summary: U0 diff parser and line-identity dependency algebra
nodes.body: Zero-context hunks as reorganization atoms; conservative whole-file degradation; commutation realized via line identity, so subset replay needs no offset arithmetic.

nodes.name: read-side
nodes.summary: Inspect pipeline and plan validation R1-R8
nodes.body: Snapshot with self-describing hunk ids, hard deps and anomalies; R8 is a constructive proof: full in-memory replay compared against head, so check passing guarantees apply succeeds.

nodes.name: write-side
nodes.summary: Apply engine, append-only op log, independent verify
nodes.body: Forge commits invisibly, assert tree invariance inside the write path, flip one CAS ref; undo appends (never rewinds); verify shares no code with apply.

nodes.name: cli
nodes.summary: ism CLI: seven commands over the core
nodes.body: status/show/inspect/check/apply/verify/undo; JSON on stdout, structured errors with stable exit codes, never interactive.

nodes.name: e2e-tests
nodes.summary: End-to-end tests: real repos, real binary, full loop
nodes.body: inspect-plan-check-apply-verify-undo round trip, error-code paths, degraded files, dirty-worktree immunity.

nodes.name: contract-infra
nodes.summary: Plan schema, same-source check, CI, README and placeholders
nodes.body: plan.v1.json is the public contract (embed source inside the crate, convention copy at root, CI-checked identical).
